exposure: assisted reproduction techniques (ART) population vs. general obstetric population
women with endometriosis vs. without endometriosis
cohort: Two populations: 1) 246 women who had Cesarean sections from a total of 1170 deliveries following ART, and 2) 7045 women who had Cesarean sections from a total of 50,298 deliveries (general obstetric population)
finding: Endometriosis is associated with a higher risk of placenta previa even after adjusting for age, IVF, multiplicity, and previous deliveries.
